run.original_sample_description: Human metagenome DNA sample from Pouch of a male participant in the dbGaP study The Role of the Gut Microbiota in Ulcerative Colitis
run.Original_Project_description: The bacteria that live in the gut are felt to play a key role in the health of the gastrointestinal tract. We will determine the role of the gut bacteria in the development of human inflammatory bowel disease through the use of state-of-the-art molecular biology techniques and advanced culture techniques
